_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Contract Summary Report
summary: The Contract Summary Report documents a summary of all work performed under the contract, including the format and content preparation instructions for the deliverable.
use_relationship:
This report summarizes all work performed under the contract.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.

This DID supersedes DI-ADMN-80447.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall be prepared in contractor's format.

children.title: It shall be typewritten and is to be duplicated in non-fading ink.
The data indicated below shall be contained on the title page:
Security classification and distribution limitation markings shall be included on all pages.
Brief summary of all work accomplished, to include both negative and positive results.
children.content: All information shall be referenced to the appropriate Progress Report, or section of the Final Report, where the subject is discussed in detail.

children.title: The body of the report shall describe all work accomplished, including as applicable, theoretical studies, experimental work mechanical design, theory of operation, test procedures, test results, and those drawings, charts, graphs, illustrations, or other material needed to clarify the presentation.
When test equipment has been designed and constructed for use on this contract, a listing of all such equipment is to be included.
children.content: This listing shall include all related drawings and associated lists. It shall be referenced in the report and included as an appendix.

children.title: Appendixes for any necessary tables, references, photographs, charts, and illustrations.
